quickref.slot: BB Heroes basic attack (wiki column 'Attack'); Ultimate is Doom Cloud
quickref.status: BB Heroes only. Botch added 2024 ('Spring 2024' per wiki; official 'NEW HERO' teaser Jul 3, 2024); BBH global launch Oct 3, 2024; Botch 'Attack Damage Increased (+15%)' in the 1.0.12 notes the wiki dates Oct 14, 2024. Not in BBR or BBG; not seen in BBG 2026 [Unverified]
quickref.look: A glowing yellow-lime domed star with four or five drooping, blunt-tipped arms, pale outline seams and zig-zag crack seams (glow about #F8FE4C; render about #B4D960, seams #CBE181). About 0.5-0.75 of Botch's head width. It hovers unheld at his shoulder and sheds lime sparkles [Observed: official BBH splash, key art, store screenshots]. It is a remodel of his 2013 Doom Cloud blob. That it is the Doom Star is [Inference]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: 'acts as a boomerang' [Canon]; range Short, reload Very slow [Fan-wiki]; a 3-segment ammo bar is seen in a fan HUD [Observed]. The throw, flight path, spin and trail are unobserved [Unverified]
quickref.impact_end_result: 'potentially dealing double damage' [Canon]; wiki '2 x 730' implies one hit going out and one coming back [Inference]. The hit visual is unobserved. A lime whirlwind around Botch and a lime ground disc with -70 ticks were seen, but neither is attributable to the Doom Star [Unverified]

quickref.status: Added 2.7, Jan 23, 2014; 75 Gas in the 2.7 store (wiki: 60 Gas); 2.17 damage glitch, 'Fixed' in 2.19 (Apr 26, 2015); HUD clip 3 in 2014–2015 and 4 in 2017 (wiki: 4); not seen in 2026
quickref.look: A glowing lime ball with short pyramid spikes, like a sea mine (#B2F546–#B3F84F). It floats beside his head, about 0.3 of his head width. The HUD, store and loadout icon is the same spiked ball. The 2015 'Bombs Away!' bundle art instead shows glossy, smooth green spheres (#6AE742) with mint swoosh trails.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: 'Fires an explosion in all 4 directions from Botch' [Game text via wiki]; one shot per 1.0 s [Fan-wiki]. A spiked lime ball is seen by his paw just after the clip empties [Observed; that it was launched is Inference]. Its flight is otherwise unseen.
quickref.impact_end_result: Bursts on contact with an enemy or surface; no status effect [Fan-wiki]. Candidate blast: a white-cream dome (#F6F8F3) with a lime base glow (#A1E250), rising lime vapour and a scorched brown ring, where an enemy died (three blue Joule bolts) [Observed in SW's 2016 custom thumbnail; attribution Inference, Nova not excluded]. The yellow-lime floor rings are unattributed.

quickref.owner: Any class (seen in Botch's Dec 2015 set)
quickref.status: BBG Special; 20 Gas, level 4, 10 s duration, 20 s cooldown [Fan-wiki]; seen in 2015 (2.23) footage
quickref.look: Card art shows a bear beside a snail. The HUD special button is an hourglass with a cooldown ring [Observed; identity Inference].
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Activated around the user; no projectile [Fan-wiki].
quickref.impact_end_result: A huge translucent yellow dome with faceted, polygon edges (#FCFB31–#FDFD5D) covers the area [Observed]. Slowed enemies show a lime-yellow 'Z' in white swirl brackets over their heads [Observed; Fan-wiki: 'yellow Z', 100 u/s slow].

open_questions: Is the hovering lime star the Doom Star, or the BBH Doom Cloud (Super) model kept from BBG? Settling it needs a frame of the basic throw, or the in-game 'i' info panel on Botch's SKILL tab, which in the frames I saw names only the Ultimate.
How does the Doom Star fly (straight out and back, or curved; spin; trail), and what does each of its two hits look like?

Which on-screen effect is the Doom Cloud Super: the lime whirlwind centred on Botch (store screenshots ss_06/ss_14 and official short 6a55EdwBmZM, ammo full), or the lime-rimmed ground disc with puddles and stacked -70 ticks (fan _vc1P7jwWEc, ammo nearly empty)?
Do skins swap the star? The fan Plague Doctor thumbnail shows a dark-green marbled orb in its place; Blotch, Emo and the other skins are unchecked.
Release date: the wiki says 'Spring 2024', but the official 'NEW HERO' teaser (eQBsn_45x5w) is dated Jul 3, 2024.
Does the Doom Star exist in the BBG 2026 re-release? No playtest frame or Steam post shows it.
